quote: The following SubmodelElements shall be specified within SMC AddressInformation: • MLP Street • MLP Zipcode • MLP CityTown • MLP NationalCode
effect: AddressInformation, which the template JSON ships without children, gets Street, Zipcode, CityTown and NationalCode as mandatory elements.

quote: The following SubmodelElements shall be specified within SMC AddressInformation: • MLP Street • MLP Zipcode • MLP CityTown • MLP NationalCode • SMC Email, if available • Property AddressOfAdditionalLink, if available for web address Additional elements from the SMT ContactInformations may be added
effect: Same four mandatory address MLPs; Email and AddressOfAdditionalLink are conditional ("if available"), so they are optional.

quote: Multiple references are made within the Submodel to the Submodel template "Contact Information", or content is taken from it, to avoid having already standardized content again.
effect: Its ContactInformation SMCs (ECLASS 0173-1#02-AAQ837, empty in the JSON) take their content from IDTA 02002 SMC ContactInformation.
SMC ContactInformation is the ECLASS contact information block, so an SMC carrying that IRDI (any revision) is a 02002 ContactInformation.
